capabilities: Generate reflective journal summaries at weekly, biweekly, monthly and yearly cadences
Apply one of 13 reflection frameworks or a custom one to summaries
Extract mood and context metadata from entries automatically
Show a locally computed insights dashboard with streaks, mood trends and outlier entries
Connect to OpenRouter or any local OpenAI-compatible server for generation and embeddings
extras: Not yet listed in Community Plugins; must be installed manually or via BRAT. Embeddings have no cloud option. The author accepts coffee donations.
motivation: The author says self-reflection is something he cares about and "this plugin is what came out of wanting a better way to do it with journal entries I was already writing anyway."
problem: Obsidian journals accumulate entries but offer no way to step back and surface patterns across them; few people make time to reread and reflect on their own writing.

relations.evidence: So OpenRouter is in there too - as an opt-in add-on you can reach for
LM Studio, llama.cpp's server, Ollama's OpenAI-compat endpoint, mlx-openai-server

requires.name: local OpenAI-compatible server (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, mlx-openai-server)

summary: AI journal companion that generates weekly, biweekly, monthly and yearly reflective summaries of daily notes via local LLM servers or OpenRouter, with mood tracking.
